description: SECTORES CRITICOS DE SINIESTRALIDAD VIAL is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Agencia Nacional de Seguridad Vial - ANSV, Bogotá D.C.. DEFINICIÓN DE TRAMOS HOMOGÉNEOS Sobre un archivo geográfico de la red vial carretera nacional, con las principales vías nacionales de la red primaria y secundaria, que se encuentre particionada en diferentes elementos los cuales no deben superar una longitud máxima de 10 kilómetros, para los elementos con una mayor longitud deben ser separados en partes ... Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Agencia Nacional de Seguridad Vial - ANSV, Bogotá D.C.. Its tags are ansv, seguridad, vías, vial, transporte. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Transporte. The portal shows 2021-04-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
